message: USAIR is a joke and by the way, so is AmericaWest.  This merger should work nicely for the two of them.  Bags lost in Philly (seeing a pattern here) after a cancelled flight to columbus for excessive air traffic.  I have flown millions of miles and have never heard of a flight being cancelled for excessive air traffic.  I took the flight to Dayton, Oh that left just a few minutes after the Columbus flight was supposed to leave and made it to Dayton.  My 6, mostly very large bags, however, are still nowhere to be found at 7:45 the following morning and very little help from the baggage claim department (they hung up on me twice just trying to transfer my call, and no I was not being a dick at that point).  I was told to call them at 10:15 this morning for an update.  In summation, the employees were rude, the airline arrived late, with numerous delays both going and returning and my bags apparently are in USAIR limbo somewhere.  Avoid this airline at all costs.  It has been the worst experience I have had in commercial air travel.
